_note: Reference ranges for sanity checks and the About screen. No figure here has been confirmed against a NASA source yet. The team must verify each one before quoting it.

resting_hr.source_note: Typical healthy adult range from general knowledge. Check against NASA-STD-3001 and HRP risk reports.

hrv.source_note: Wide adult range from general knowledge. Strongly age dependent. No NASA source yet.

bp_sys.source_note: Common adult range from general knowledge. Check against NASA-STD-3001.

bp_dia.source_note: Common adult range from general knowledge. Check against NASA-STD-3001.

ortho_rise.source_note: Stand test rise from general knowledge. Check against HRP cardiovascular risk reports.

spo2.source_note: Common adult range from general knowledge. Cabin pressure may change this.

exercise_min.source_note: Assumed daily exercise block. Check against HRP bone and muscle reports.

exercise_load.source_note: Invented unit for this prototype. No real equivalent.

grip.source_note: Adult range from general knowledge. No NASA source yet.

bone_marker.source_note: Invented index for this prototype. Real markers need lab assays. Check OSDR and Twin Study papers.

lean_mass.source_note: Adult proxy range from general knowledge. No NASA source yet.

temp.source_note: Common adult range from general knowledge. Spaceflight may shift core temperature. Check HRP reports.

crp.source_note: Common lab range from general knowledge. Check Twin Study papers.

il6.source_note: Common lab range from general knowledge. Assays vary. Check Twin Study papers.

lymph.source_note: Common lab range from general knowledge. Check OSDR.

sleep_hours.source_note: Common adult guidance from general knowledge. Check HRP behavioral reports and analog missions.

sleep_eff.source_note: Common sleep study range from general knowledge. Check analog missions.

mood.source_note: Scale invented for this prototype. Check HI-SEAS, SIRIUS and CHAPEA methods.

stress.source_note: Scale invented for this prototype. Check HI-SEAS, SIRIUS and CHAPEA methods.

journal.source_note: Output range of this prototype's own word list.

career_limit_msv.source_note: Approximate NASA career limit given in the project brief. Confirm in NASA-STD-3001.

mars_round_trip_dose_sv.source_note: Approximate figure given in the project brief, attributed to the Curiosity RAD instrument. Confirm the original paper.

daily_dose_msv.source_note: Derived from the round trip figure above: 0.66 Sv over about 360 days.

one_way_delay_minutes.source_note: Upper estimate given in the project brief. The real delay changes with planet positions.
